text.description_html:
First Impressions 8 Inch Modern Acrylic Shower Door Handle

This 8" with 6" center to center Clear Acrylic Shower Door Handle comes packaged with everything you'll need to mount it on a glass shower door. It is made from clear acrylic with Polished Chrome mounting brackets The retro-modern design is really stunning. Our pictures do not do them justice.

Specifications for the First Impressions 8 Inch Modern Shower Door Pull:

  • Pull Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass with Polished Chrome Finish
  • Total Length: 8"
  • Center to Center Mount: 6"
  • Width: 1"
  • Thickness: 5/8"
  • Clearance: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2"
  • Door Mounting: Thru-Bolt mounted for 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

Packaged with 1 door pull, 2 inside screw covers, plus mounting hardware for mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

Sold Individually
